The isolated test combination preserves current production and applies only the demonstrated post-2011 test delta; the author's actual conflict resolution still needs to retain those changes and the newer tests. Minimal CI should run after that resolution.

@@ -581,6 +581,32 @@ def _warp_amax_u32(value: str, mask: str) -> str:
     )
 
 
+def _f8_128x4_k_padding(quant: BlockQuantizeSpec, swapped: bool) -> bool:
+    """Whether an F8_128x4 scale row can end in K padding slots.
+
+    A blob row holds ``roundup(blocks, 4)`` scale slots. Grouped token-axis
+    segments hold none: their groups start at multiples of ``4 * block_size``."""
+    token_axis = (quant.axis == 1) != swapped
+    return quant.scale_reorder == "F8_128x4" and not (quant.grouped_by_moe and token_axis)
+
+
+def _emit_f8_128x4_k_pad_zero(quant: BlockQuantizeSpec, block: str, num_blocks: str, sidx: str, scale_tap_idx: int) -> list[str]:
+    """Zero the padding slots after a scale row's last real block.
+
+    A consumer whose K is the quantized axis multiplies them against its zero-filled
+    K tail, so a stale NaN encoding (E8M0 0xFF, E4M3 0x7F/0xFF) poisons its whole output
+    row. They share the last block's 4-byte quad, so the lane storing that block
+    writes them. Rows that pad the blob to a whole 128-row atom stay unwritten: only
+    consumer rows that are never stored read them."""
+    store_dtype = _scale_store_dtype(quant.scale_dtype)
+    zero = "cutlass.Int8(0)" if store_dtype == "cutlass.Int8" else f"cutlass.Int8(0).bitcast({store_dtype})"
+    lines = [f"if {block} + 1 == {num_blocks}:"]
+    for slot in range(1, 4):
+        lines.append(f"    if {block} % 4 < {4 - slot}:")
+        lines.append(f"        (gC_tap_{scale_tap_idx}_ptr + {sidx} + {slot}).store({zero}, alignment=1)")
+    return lines
+
+

@@ -3522,6 +3522,137 @@ def test_sm120_render_smoke() -> None:
                 assert f"b_is_n_major = {b_major == 'n'}" in src, combo
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("axes,M,N", [((-1,), 200, 2880), ((-1, 1), 352, 320)], ids=["row", "row_col"])
+def test_sm120_quant_scale_k_padding_is_zeroed(axes, M, N) -> None:
+    """An F8_128x4 quant-scale row holds roundup(blocks, 4) slots. A block-scaled
+    GEMM whose K is the quantized axis reads the padding slots against its
+    zero-filled K tail, so a stale 0xFF (the E8M0 NaN) there turns the whole
+    output row into NaN. The epilogue must write them as 0, whatever the caller's
+    buffer held: here 0xFF. Rows past the last real row of a 128-row atom stay
+    unchecked. ``row_col`` also runs the row quant under the col quant's row
+    predicate."""
+    cfg = _resolve("CONFIG_sm120_128x128x128_16x16x32_cluster1x1_warps4x2")
+    _skip_unless_active(cfg)  # the sm100 tree's quant chunk check declines this config before its family check
+    K, bs = 128, 32
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    A = g.tensor(name="A", dim=[1, M, K], stride=_a_stride_batched(M, K, "k"))
+    B = g.tensor(name="B", dim=[1, K, N], stride=_b_stride_batched(N, K, "k"))
+    C = g.matmul(A=A, B=B, name="mm")
+    a, b, _ = _mkdata(M, N, K, "bf16", "bf16")
+    mm = torch.einsum("bmk,bnk->bmn", a.float(), b.float())
+    vp, checks = {A: a, B: b}, []
+    for qi, axis in enumerate(axes):
+        Q, QS = g.block_scale_quantize(input=C, block_size=bs, axis=axis, name=f"q{qi}")
+        Q.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+        rows, blocks = (M, N // bs) if axis == -1 else (N, M // bs)
+        dims = [1, (rows + 127) // 128 * 128, (blocks + 3) // 4 * 4]
+        QS.set_dim(dims).set_stride([dims[1] * dims[2], dims[2], 1])
+        QS.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0)
+        QS.set_reordering_type(cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4)
+        vp[Q] = torch.empty(1, M, N, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda")
+        vp[QS] = torch.full(dims, 0xFF, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda").view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+        if axis == -1:
+            q_ref, s_ref = _block_quant_reference(mm, bs, torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+            addr = _f8_row_scale_addr(M, dims[2] * bs, bs)
+        else:
+            q_ref, s_ref = _col_quant_reference(mm, bs, torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+            s_ref = s_ref.transpose(1, 2)
+            addr = _f8_col_scale_addr(dims[2] * bs, N, bs)
+        expected = torch.zeros(rows, dims[2], dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+        expected[:, :blocks] = s_ref[0].view(torch.uint8)
+        checks.append((Q, QS, q_ref, addr, expected))
+
+    compiled = _plan(g, config=cfg)
+    assert [q.axis == 1 for q in compiled.chain.quants] == [axis == 1 for axis in axes]
+    compiled(vp)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    for Q, QS, q_ref, addr, expected in checks:
+        torch.testing.assert_close(vp[QS].view(torch.uint8).flatten()[addr], expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(vp[Q].float(), q_ref.float(), atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+class _Rendered(Exception):
+    """Raised in place of the DSL compile, to carry the rendered kernel source out of jit_from_cudnn_graph."""
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["plain", "bounded_rows", "swap_ab"])
+def test_sm120_quant_scale_k_padding_render(monkeypatch, case) -> None:
+    """Host-only twin of test_sm120_quant_scale_k_padding_is_zeroed: the kernel is
+    rendered, not compiled, through the sm120 tree's compiler by name, so this also
+    runs where those GPU tests skip. The sm120 ``_emit_block_quant`` appends the row
+    quant's padding stores behind the shared ``_emit_block_quant_row``, repeating that
+    emitter's store guard and reading its ``_q{i}_scol{k}`` / ``_q{i}_sidx{k}``. Each
+    row-quant scale store must be followed by a padding block under the same guard, so
+    changing either in the shared emitter fails here. ``plain`` has no row predicate,
+    ``bounded_rows`` runs the row quant under the col quant's row predicate (the col
+    quant pads right after each of its own stores), and ``swap_ab`` is the MoE
+    token-axis quant, bounded by ``group_end``."""
+    import re
+    from dataclasses import replace
+
+    from cudnn.gemm.frost.sm120 import compiler as C120
+
+    bs, bf16, f32 = 32, cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, cudnn.data_type.FLOAT
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=bf16, intermediate_data_type=f32, compute_data_type=f32)
+    if case == "swap_ab":  # the token-axis quant is the row quant of the weight-by-token kernel
+        E, M, N, K, axes = 4, 352, 128, 128, (1,)
+        tok = g.tensor(name="token", dim=[1, M, K], stride=[M * K, K, 1], data_type=bf16)
+        w = g.tensor(name="weight", dim=[E, K, N], stride=[K * N, 1, K], data_type=bf16)
+        fto = g.tensor(name="first_token_offset", dim=[E + 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+        fto.set_alignment_value(bs)
+        out = g.moe_grouped_matmul(tok, w, fto, mode=cudnn.moe_grouped_matmul_mode.NONE, compute_data_type=f32, name="moe")
+    else:
+        M, N, K, axes = (200, 2880, 128, (-1,)) if case == "plain" else (352, 320, 128, (-1, 1))
+        A = g.tensor(name="A", dim=[1, M, K], stride=_a_stride_batched(M, K, "k"))
+        B = g.tensor(name="B", dim=[1, K, N], stride=_b_stride_batched(N, K, "k"))
+        out = g.matmul(A=A, B=B, name="mm")
+    for qi, axis in enumerate(axes):
+        Q, QS = g.block_scale_quantize(input=out, block_size=bs, axis=axis, name=f"q{qi}")
+        Q.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3)
+        rows, blocks = (M, N // bs) if axis == -1 else (N, M // bs)
+        dims = [1, (rows + 127) // 128 * 128, (blocks + 3) // 4 * 4]
+        QS.set_dim(dims).set_stride([dims[1] * dims[2], dims[2], 1])
+        QS.set_output(True).set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0)
+        QS.set_reordering_type(cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4)
+
+    def render_only(src):
+        raise _Rendered(src)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(C120, "_import_kernel", render_only)
+    cfg = by_name("CONFIG_sm120_128x128x128_16x16x32_cluster1x1_warps4x2")
+    with pytest.raises(_Rendered) as rendered:
+        C120.jit_from_cudnn_graph(g, config=replace(cfg, swap_ab=case == "swap_ab"))
+    lines = rendered.value.args[0].splitlines()
+
+    def guard(i: int) -> str | None:
+        """The line that opens the block holding line ``i``."""
+        depth = len(lines[i]) - len(lines[i].lstrip())
+        return next((s.strip() for s in reversed(lines[:i]) if s.strip() and not s.lstrip().startswith("#") and len(s) - len(s.lstrip()) < depth), None)
+
+    define = re.compile(r"\s*(_q\d+_(?:scol|sidx)\d+) = .+")
+    row_store = re.compile(r"\s*\(gC_tap_\d+_ptr \+ (_q\d+)_sidx(\d+)\)\.store\(\1_scale\2, alignment=1\)")
+    row_pad = re.compile(rf"\s*if (_q\d+)_scol(\d+) \+ 1 == \(N // {bs}\):")
+    col_store = re.compile(r"\s*\(gC_tap_\d+_ptr \+ (_q\d+)_sidx\d+\)\.store\(\1_scale_mine\[\d+\], alignment=1\)")
+    defined, stores, pads, col_pads = set(), [], [], 0
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        m = define.fullmatch(line)
+        if m:
+            defined.add(m[1])
+        m = row_store.fullmatch(line)
+        if m:
+            stores.append((m[1], m[2], guard(i)))
+        m = row_pad.fullmatch(line)
+        if m:
+            assert {f"{m[1]}_scol{m[2]}", f"{m[1]}_sidx{m[2]}"} <= defined, f"padding reads names the shared row emitter no longer defines: {line.strip()}"
+            pads.append((m[1], m[2], guard(i)))
+        m = col_store.fullmatch(line)
+        if m:
+            assert lines[i + 1].strip() == f"if {m[1]}_mb + 1 == (M // {bs}):", lines[i : i + 2]
+            col_pads += 1
+    assert stores and pads == stores, f"row-quant scale stores {stores} vs padding blocks {pads}"
+    assert (col_pads > 0) == (case == "bounded_rows")
+
+

+    cols = _ceil_div(blocks, 4) * 4
+    dims = (1, segmented_row_scale_capacity_rows(S, num_groups) if grouped else _ceil_div(S, 128) * 128, cols)
+    g = _build_graph(E, S, N, K, num_groups, combo="mxfp8", quant=True, quant_scale_reorder=True, quant_scale_dim=dims, quant_group_offset=grouped)
+    compiled = _plan(g, config=by_name(_SM120_BS_CFG), swap_ab=swap_ab)
+
+    # Small integers under unit E8M0 scales keep the GEMM, and so the quant reference, exact.
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    token = torch.randint(-2, 3, (1, S, K), device="cuda").float().to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    weight = torch.randint(-2, 3, (E, N, K), device="cuda").float().to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    sfa = torch.full((1, segmented_row_scale_capacity_rows(S, num_groups), sf_k), 0x7F, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    sfb = torch.full((E, _ceil_div(N, 128) * 128, _ceil_div(sf_k, 4) * 4), 0x7F, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    q = torch.empty(1, S, N, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda")
+    scale = torch.full(dims, 0xFF, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    offsets = torch.tensor(offsets_list, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    e8m0 = torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    compiled(_vp_bs(compiled, token, weight, [q, scale.view(e8m0)], sfa.view(e8m0), sfb.view(e8m0), fto=offsets))
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    ref = torch.zeros((S, N), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    live, base = [], 0
+    for gi, (begin, end) in enumerate(zip(offsets_list, offsets_list[1:])):
+        ref[begin:end] = token[0, begin:end].float() @ weight[gi % E].float().T
+        live.extend(range(base, base + end - begin) if grouped else range(begin, end))

+    expected = torch.zeros(S, cols, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    expected[:, :blocks] = s_ref[0].view(torch.uint8)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(_f8_128x4_logical(scale, cols)[live], expected, atol=0, rtol=0)

+def _f8_128x4_logical(blob: torch.Tensor, cols: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Undo an F8_128x4 blob's reordering: (rows rounded up to 128, cols) bytes."""
+    flat = blob.view(torch.uint8).flatten()
+    order = _to_blocked(torch.arange(flat.numel(), device=flat.device).view(-1, cols))
+    logical = torch.empty_like(flat)
+    logical[order] = flat
+    return logical.view(-1, cols)
+

+def test_moe_quant_scale_k_padding_is_zeroed_sm120(axis, swap_ab):
+    """MoE twin of test_matmul.py::test_sm120_quant_scale_k_padding_is_zeroed: the
+    slots after each real scale row's last block come out 0 from a 0xFF buffer. Each
+    axis is the row quant in one kernel orientation and the col quant in the other."""
+    from gemm_test_utils import skip_unless_pipeline_active
+
+    skip_unless_pipeline_active(by_name(_SM120_CFG))  # the sm100 tree's quant chunk check declines this config before its family check
+    E, K, bs = 4, 128, 32
+    # 11 token blocks pad to 12, 5 feature blocks to 8; the last group ends at S.
+    groups, N = ([96, 0, 128, 128], 128) if axis == 1 else ([100, 0, 120, 80], 160)
+    S = sum(groups)
+    rows, blocks = (N, S // bs) if axis == 1 else (S, N // bs)
+    dims = (1, _ceil_div(rows, 128) * 128, _ceil_div(blocks, 4) * 4)
+    g = cudnn.pygraph(io_data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16, intermediate_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT)
+    tok = g.tensor(name="token", dim=[1, S, K], stride=[S * K, K, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    w = g.tensor(name="weight", dim=[E, K, N], stride=[K * N, 1, K], data_type=cudnn.data_type.BFLOAT16)
+    fto = g.tensor(name="first_token_offset", dim=[E + 1, 1, 1], stride=[1, 1, 1], data_type=cudnn.data_type.INT32)
+    if axis == 1:
+        fto.set_alignment_value(bs)  # token-axis blocks never straddle a group
+    out = g.moe_grouped_matmul(tok, w, fto, mode=cudnn.moe_grouped_matmul_mode.NONE, compute_data_type=cudnn.data_type.FLOAT, name="moe")
+    q, q_scale = g.block_scale_quantize(input=out, block_size=bs, axis=axis, name="q")
+    q.set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E4M3).set_output(True)
+    q_scale.set_dim(list(dims)).set_stride([dims[1] * dims[2], dims[2], 1])
+    q_scale.set_data_type(cudnn.data_type.FP8_E8M0).set_output(True)
+    q_scale.set_reordering_type(cudnn.tensor_reordering.F8_128x4)
+    compiled = _plan(g, config=by_name(_SM120_CFG), swap_ab=swap_ab)
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    token = torch.randint(-2, 2, (1, S, K), device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    weight = torch.randint(-2, 2, (E, N, K), device="cuda").to(torch.bfloat16)
+    offsets = _offsets(groups, S)
+    q_buf = torch.empty(1, S, N, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn, device="cuda")
+    scale_buf = torch.full(dims, 0xFF, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    compiled({tok: token, w: weight, fto: offsets, q: q_buf, q_scale: scale_buf.view(torch.float8_e8m0fnu)})
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+
+    ref = _ref_f32(token, weight, offsets, S, N, E)
+    q_ref, s_ref = _block_quant_ref(ref.T.contiguous() if axis == 1 else ref, bs, torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e8m0fnu)
+    expected = torch.zeros(rows, dims[2], dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    expected[:, :blocks] = s_ref[0].view(torch.uint8)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(_f8_128x4_logical(scale_buf, dims[2])[:rows], expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
